title: SnapOtter
descript: SnapOtter is a self-hosted image toolkit: convert, resize, compress, crop and batch-process photos in the browser while the files stay on your NAS. This package runs the official Docker Hub image with its own PostgreSQL database and Redis cache as non-root containers; all data lives in the application data folder.
important: First run: open the web UI and log in with the default admin/admin, then change the password immediately. The stack contains three containers (app, PostgreSQL, Redis) that are only reachable from the app. Data lives under /Volume1/DockerAppData/snapotterdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

trial_run.log_tail:
FATAL: embedded mode needs root to run the in-container database (uid=1000).
Run the container as root (the default), or use the Compose 3-container stack,
or set DATABASE_URL + REDIS_URL to point at external services.
